header: What the search line needs to know about this topic (pure, no React): the words of the AICPI, SAIL DA and inflation card ("aicpi da", "sail da"). The data, its source and its checks are in src/lib/live/aicpi.ts; how it looks is in AicpiCard.tsx and ui.tsx. I list it once, in src/tools/registry.ts. I treat a line as this card's when it has a key word and every word is a key word, an extra word or a filler: "da formula" opens it, "da vinci" does not. Hyphens read as spaces, so "cpi-iw" is "cpi" and "iw".
